observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: Demonstrations are performed by three dancers in front of a blue curtain with on-screen text and English subtitles. No spoken voice is heard, only written subtitles and demonstrations.

lesson_structure.note: Introduction to the Trojak dance origin and style
Obroty pod ręką partnera (Turns under partners' arms)

steps_taught.name: Krok podstawowy
steps_taught.description: Basic step moving sideways with bent knees and foot extensions.

steps_taught.name: Ukłon
steps_taught.description: Bow with steps forward and deep knee bends.

steps_taught.name: Obroty tancerek
steps_taught.description: Female turns on the spot with final foot stamps.

steps_taught.name: Skoki tancerzy
steps_taught.description: Male jumps with leg extensions and opening legs.

steps_taught.name: Haczyki
steps_taught.description: Arm hooks and linking elbows while turning.

steps_taught.name: Obieganie
steps_taught.description: Circling around the male partner in running steps.

steps_taught.name: Kółeczko
steps_taught.description: Dancers form a circle holding hands and moving right.

steps_taught.name: Obroty pod ręką partnera
steps_taught.description: Female turns under partners arms facing him.

steps_taught.name: Zawinięcie
steps_taught.description: Spinning in and out of partner's arms with walking steps and stamps.

what_works: Clear on-screen titles and English subtitles for each step
Demonstration by professional dancers with music
what_hinders: No spoken instruction or verbal cues

quotes.text: Trojak is a well known dance from Upper Silesia.
It is performed by three people - 1 male and 2 female dancers.
In Trojak we use the following steps: walking, running, jumping

evidence_segments.observation: Three dancers stand in a line on stage with blue curtains, preparing for the basic step demonstration.
evidence_segments.cannot_infer: exact foot placement details from distance

extraction.distinctive_method: Purely visual demonstration format using on-screen text chapters and background music without any spoken teacher instruction.
